ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Hindustan Zinc Limited (HZL) has entered a six-year transportation agreement with MFL India Limited to deploy 30 electric trucks for concentrate transportation, accelerating its mine-to-smelter decarbonization initiative. This strategic move aligns with HZL's commitment to achieving Net Zero emissions by 2050, enhancing its sustainability profile and aiming for long-term operational competitiveness through cleaner logistics. No material red flags are evident, with the company framing the adoption of this emerging technology as a managed, phased transition.
